outlook.discussion: 1. Eastern East Pacific (EP96): An area of low pressure located just offshore of Nicaragua has been producing increasingly organized shower and thunderstorm activity over the past several hours. Some additional development of this system is possible through early Monday while it drifts slowly northwestward. Thereafter, environmental conditions are forecast to become unfavorable for further development as the system turns westward away from land.
